claude_proposed_widenings.name: modify_movement
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Jump's core mechanic is a timed movement enhancement: the target can jump up to 30 ft by spending only 10 ft of movement on each of its turns. OngoingOperation only has roll_modifier and damage_on_hit — neither captures movement modification. A new variant is needed (e.g. modify_movement or grant_jump) to express this shape as an ongoing operation under the ongoing_effect family.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Once on each of its turns until the spell ends, that creature can jump up to 30 feet by spending 10 feet of movement.
